--a son of Hetru and father of two sons. वा. ६९. १२८. [page३-113+ २८]

--a pupil of पौष्यञ्जि: learnt a hundred साम samhitas.
1: भा.
--a daughter of दक्ष, wife of Dharma and mother of घोष. Vi. I. १५. १०५, १०७.

(I)--a son of शुद्धोद, and father of Prase- najit;
1: भा. IX. १२. १४.
in charge of a सम्हिता.
2: Br. II. ३५. ४७.
--a वानर chief born of स्वेता. Br.

(I)--one of the four pupils of पौष्यञ्जि; a श्रु- तऋषि;
1: Br. II. ३३. 8; ३५. ४०; वा. ६१. ३६; Vi.

(II)--is बलराम; entered मिथिला and was received with presents by Maithila; after having chastised कृष्ण for having killed शतधन्व when he did not have the Syamantaka saying that he could have nothing to do with द्वारका or कृष्ण; but entreated by the वृष्णिस् and Andhakas, was brought back to द्वारका; see Hala (Bala- deva). Br. III. ७१. ७७; Vi. V. २५. 6, 9; वा. ९६, ७५-8, ८४.
(III)--an अवतार् of the Lord in the २२न्द् dva1- para in वाराणसी with हला for weapon and with four righteous sons. वा. २३. १९९.
--a R. from the Mahendra hill. Br. II. १६. ३७; वा. ४५. १०६.
